preconditions: The cluster starts with all replicas in sync, RF=3, write caching disabled, and all benchmark writes use acks=all quorum acknowledgement.
The kafka-2 persistent volume remains available after fault injection.
The fault injector records the exact benchmark-owned startup override.

Prove which replicas contain the latest acknowledged offsets before any storage action.

payload.rationale: Logs from pod kafka-2 confirm that redpanda fails startup with exit code 1 due to 'Argument parse error: unrecognised option '--proofix-invalid-startup-flag''. The StatefulSet startup script injects /etc/proofix/override/extra_args from ConfigMap kafka-startup-override specifically for kafka-2. The underlying PVC data-kafka-2 is Bound and healthy. Clearing the extra_args override in ConfigMap kafka-startup-override allows kafka-2 to start normally using its existing persistent data, restoring the cluster ISR without risking data loss.
payload.rollback_trigger: kafka-2 fails to exit CrashLoopBackOff after ConfigMap update or persistent storage corruption prevents startup.

success_criteria.description: Pod kafka-2 redpanda container starts successfully and passes readiness probes, broker 2 rejoins the Redpanda/Kafka cluster, in-sync replicas (ISR) are restored to 3 across all partitions, under-replicated partition count drops to 0, and client produce/fetch latencies satisfy SLO.
